+# ミニマップ・技能能力の再現用資料
+
+ローカルに残っていた作者作成の限定モデル、専用テスト、監査JSONを、元ファイルと同じバイト列で回収しました。
+対応する研究本文は [ミニマップの解析](../DEVLAB_MINIMAP_NATIVE_CONTRACT_20261011.md) と [技能能力の解析](../DEVLAB_NATIVE_SKILL_CAPABILITY_20261011.md) です。
+
+## 内容
+
+| 研究 | 実装 | テスト | 監査記録 |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| ミニマップのセル算術・頂点配列 | [Pythonモデル](src/hakushin_compat/native_minimap_static_subset.py) | [専用テスト](tests/test_native_minimap_static_subset.py) | [JSON](reports/MINIMAP_NATIVE_STATIC_AUDIT_20261011.json) |
+| 技能種別と能力バイトの局所分岐 | [Pythonモデル](src/hakushin_compat/native_skill_capability_subset.py) | [専用テスト](tests/test_native_skill_capability_subset.py) | [JSON](reports/NATIVE_SKILL_CAPABILITY_SUBSET_20261011.json) |
+
+元資料と回収先のSHA-256、照合範囲は [回収台帳](DEV_EVIDENCE_LEDGER.tsv) にあります。
+回収時には正本と13件のオープンPRの先端ツリーでファイル名を検索し、該当ファイルが存在しないことを確認しました。
+
+## ゲームを使わない再現
+
+Python 3.12で、リポジトリのルートから次を実行します。外部パッケージは不要です。
+
+```powershell
+$env:PYTHONPATH = (Resolve-Path research/recovered/dev_evidence/src).Path
+python -B -m unittest discover -s research/recovered/dev_evidence/tests -p test_native_skill_capability_subset.py -v
+python -B -m unittest discover -s research/recovered/dev_evidence/tests -p test_native_minimap_static_subset.py -v
+```
+
+2026年11月5日の回収先での再実行は、技能能力が12件成功、ミニマップが22件成功・3件スキップでした。
+ミニマップの3件は保存済み逆コンパイルZIPに依存する照合で、そのZIPは同梱していません。
+監査JSON内の過去の25件成功は当時の記録として保持しています。現在の配布資料だけでその3件を検証したことにはなりません。
+ミニマップJSONに記されたモデルとテストのSHA-256は、今回回収した2ファイルと一致しました。
+
+これらは局所的な算術・分岐の合成テストです。原作実機の動作、最終的な技能集合、霧の意味、実画面の座標変換、ゲーム全体の互換性は別の検証項目です。

+"""Bounded model of a saved Ghidra *subset* of original MiniMapWnd.
+
+Evidence (existing decompile ZIP only):
+  0x4DD8C0: separate 2D COLORREF grid, ceil cell spans, GDI rectangles.
+  0x4DE330: already-transformed coordinates / 8, clamped overlay index;
+            two overlay vertex color DWORD writes.
+  0x4DE690: two mouse-drag slots are reset to the native sentinel.
+  0x4DE410: mouse/camera effects exist; mapping is not proven here.
+The color grid's producer, full transform, fog meaning, raster clipping,
+battle runtime and user-visible parity are explicitly NOT reconstructed.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+NATIVE_RASTER_VA = 0x4DD8C0
+NATIVE_OVERLAY_VA = 0x4DE330
+NATIVE_DRAG_RESET_VA = 0x4DE690
+NATIVE_INPUT_VA = 0x4DE410
+NATIVE_NO_COORD = 0x80000008
+MAX_CELLS = 1_000_000
+
+
+class MiniMapContractUnknown(ValueError):
+    """Outside the narrow native branch established from saved evidence."""
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class DirectRgbColorGrid:
+    """Caller-provided, row-major direct COLORREF values; not raw .map tags.
+
+    Only Win32 direct RGB 0x00BBGGRR is accepted.  Palette-index / system
+    COLORREF variants need separate original native verification.
+    """
+    rows: tuple[tuple[int, ...], ...]
+
+    def __post_init__(self):
+        if type(self.rows) is not tuple or not self.rows:
+            raise MiniMapContractUnknown("nonempty tuple of rows required")
+        width = len(self.rows[0]) if type(self.rows[0]) is tuple else 0
+        if not width or width * len(self.rows) > MAX_CELLS:
+            raise MiniMapContractUnknown("bounded positive grid shape required")
+        for row in self.rows:
+            if type(row) is not tuple or len(row) != width:
+                raise MiniMapContractUnknown("all grid rows must be rectangular tuples")
+            if any(type(v) is not int or not 0 <= v <= 0xFFFFFF for v in row):
+                raise MiniMapContractUnknown("direct Win32 RGB COLORREF only")
+
+    @property
+    def columns(self) -> int:
+        return len(self.rows[0])
+
+    @property
+    def row_count(self) -> int:
+        return len(self.rows)
+
+    def colorref(self, column: int, row: int) -> int:
+        if (type(column) is not int or type(row) is not int
+                or not 0 <= column < self.columns
+                or not 0 <= row < self.row_count):
+            raise MiniMapContractUnknown("grid indices outside validated source")
+        return self.rows[row][column]
+
+
+def direct_colorref_to_rgb(value: int) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
+    """Interpret Win32 0x00BBGGRR only, never renderer alpha or palette bits."""
+    if type(value) is not int or not 0 <= value <= 0xFFFFFF:
+        raise MiniMapContractUnknown("unknown COLORREF variant")
+    return value & 255, (value >> 8) & 255, (value >> 16) & 255
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class NativeCellSpans:
+    width_pixels: int
+    height_pixels: int
+    source_rows: int
+    source_columns: int
+    step_x: int
+    step_y: int
+    coordinate_transform_reconstructed: bool = False
+
+
+def proven_ceil_cell_spans(
+    color_grid: DirectRgbColorGrid, span_x: int, span_y: int
+) -> NativeCellSpans:
+    """0x4DD8C0 calls ceil helper 0x5B6ED0 on abs(span)/grid dims.
+
+    x87/pixel placement & 0x4DCCB0 transformation are a SEPARATE barrier.
+    No original screen origin or D3DX transform is inferred by this call.
+    """
+    if type(color_grid) is not DirectRgbColorGrid:
+        raise MiniMapContractUnknown("typed source grid required")
+    if (type(span_x) is not int or type(span_y) is not int
+            or not 0 < abs(span_x) <= 8192
+            or not 0 < abs(span_y) <= 8192):
+        raise MiniMapContractUnknown("bounded nonzero display spans required")
+    return NativeCellSpans(
+        abs(span_x), abs(span_y), color_grid.row_count, color_grid.columns,
+        (abs(span_x) + color_grid.columns - 1) // color_grid.columns,
+        (abs(span_y) + color_grid.row_count - 1) // color_grid.row_count,

+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class RelativeColorRectangle:
+    """Relative axis-aligned study plan; not native D3DX screen coordinates."""
+    column: int
+    row: int
+    local_left: int
+    local_top: int
+    local_right: int
+    local_bottom: int
+    source_colorref: int

+    @property
+    def direct_rgb(self) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
+        return direct_colorref_to_rgb(self.source_colorref)

+def synthetic_axis_aligned_rectangles(
+    grid: DirectRgbColorGrid, spans: NativeCellSpans
+) -> tuple[RelativeColorRectangle, ...]:
+    """Display-agnostic rectangle list, only after explicit axis selection.
+
+    Does not replicate 0x4DCCB0's origin/centering/matrix path or GDI clip.
+    The final cells intentionally may extend beyond spans (ceil rectangle).
+    """
+    if type(grid) is not DirectRgbColorGrid or type(spans) is not NativeCellSpans:
+        raise MiniMapContractUnknown("typed native scalar cells and spans required")
+    if (grid.columns, grid.row_count) != (spans.source_columns, spans.source_rows):
+        raise MiniMapContractUnknown("source color grid/spans mismatch")
+    if (spans.coordinate_transform_reconstructed or spans.width_pixels <= 0
+            or spans.height_pixels <= 0 or
+            spans.step_x != (spans.width_pixels + grid.columns - 1)//grid.columns
+            or spans.step_y != (spans.height_pixels + grid.row_count - 1)//grid.row_count):
+        raise MiniMapContractUnknown("unsupported/forged native cell transform")
+    return tuple(
+        RelativeColorRectangle(column, row, column * spans.step_x,
+                               row * spans.step_y, (column+1)*spans.step_x,
+                               (row+1)*spans.step_y, grid.colorref(column,row))
+        for row in range(grid.row_count) for column in range(grid.columns)
+    )

+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class OverlayPatch:
+    """0x4DE330: both corresponding vertex-color DWORD slots get this value."""
+    overlay_column: int
+    overlay_row: int
+    linear_index: int
+    vertex_color_dword: int
+    same_value_written_to_two_vertices: bool = True
+    fog_or_visibility_gameplay_meaning_verified: bool = False
+
+
+def native_overlay_patch_for_transformed_coordinate(
+    transformed_x: int, transformed_y: int,
+    overlay_columns: int, overlay_rows: int, *,
+    param3_nonzero: bool, stored_alpha_byte: int
+) -> OverlayPatch:
+    """ONLY for already-transformed integer positions from 0x4DE330.
+
+    32-bit signed division by 8 truncates toward zero; then indices clamp.
+    Native screen/world transform and caller visibility effects are unknown.
+    """
+    for name, value in (
+        ("transformed_x", transformed_x), ("transformed_y", transformed_y)):
+        if type(value) is not int or not -(1<<31) <= value < (1<<31):
+            raise MiniMapContractUnknown(name + " must be raw signed int32")
+    if (type(overlay_columns) is not int or type(overlay_rows) is not int
+            or not 1 <= overlay_columns <= 4096
+            or not 1 <= overlay_rows <= 4096
+            or overlay_columns*overlay_rows > MAX_CELLS):
+        raise MiniMapContractUnknown("bounded positive native overlay grid required")
+    if (type(param3_nonzero) is not bool or type(stored_alpha_byte) is not int
+            or not 0 <= stored_alpha_byte <= 255):
+        raise MiniMapContractUnknown("native arg3 and alpha require exact types")
+
+    def index(raw: int, limit: int) -> int:
+        # C x86 expression (raw + ((raw>>31)&7)) >> 3, then clamp 0..N-1.
+        truncated = raw//8 if raw >= 0 else -((-raw)//8)
+        return max(0, min(limit-1, truncated))
+
+    col = index(transformed_x, overlay_columns)
+    row = index(transformed_y, overlay_rows)
+    dword = 0 if param3_nonzero else stored_alpha_byte << 24
+    return OverlayPatch(col, row, overlay_columns*row+col, dword)

+# Caller-supplied grid size; no proof of original .map -> grid dimensions.
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class NativeOverlayMeshTopology:
+    """Two 0x18-byte vertex slots per 8-cell sampling-grid point.
+
+    0x008A307C/80/84 are counters read from the saved 0x4DD8C0
+    decompilation. This is not an actual fog/visibility shader model.
+    """
+    source_columns: int
+    source_rows: int
+    overlay_columns: int
+    overlay_rows: int
+    vertex_slot_count: int
+    vertex_byte_stride: int = 0x18
+    color_grid_producer_verified: bool = False
+    vertex_screen_positions_verified: bool = False
+    visual_blend_mode_verified: bool = False
+
+
+def native_overlay_mesh_topology_from_grid_shape(
+    source_columns: int, source_rows: int, *, flag_1eeee0_nonzero: bool
+) -> NativeOverlayMeshTopology | None:
+    """Local 0x4DD8C0 calculation, NOT original scene/color producer.
+
+    +0x1EEEE0==0 skips the initialization branch in this function;
+    it does not prove another owner destroyed existing overlay state.
+    Source dimensions are validated even for the disabled branch.
+    """
+    if (type(source_columns) is not int or type(source_rows) is not int
+            or type(flag_1eeee0_nonzero) is not bool
+            or not 1 <= source_columns <= 8192
+            or not 1 <= source_rows <= 8192
+            or source_columns * source_rows > MAX_CELLS):
+        raise MiniMapContractUnknown("unknown or oversized source grid shape")
+    if not flag_1eeee0_nonzero:
+        return None
+    cols = (source_columns // 8) + 1
+    rows = (source_rows // 8) + 1
+    count = 2 * cols * rows
+    return NativeOverlayMeshTopology(
+        source_columns, source_rows, cols, rows, count)
+
+
+def native_overlay_vertex_slot_pair(
+    layout: NativeOverlayMeshTopology, column: int, row: int
+) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    """Saved decomp's 0x4DD8C0 serpentine row layout.
+
+    Even rows advance from left to right; odd rows store grid cells in
+    reverse order. The two 0x18-byte vertices stay adjacent for a cell.
+    This is *buffer indexing*, not confirmed GPU primitive topology.
+    """
+    if type(layout) is not NativeOverlayMeshTopology:
+        raise MiniMapContractUnknown("native overlay layout required")
+    reference = native_overlay_mesh_topology_from_grid_shape(
+        layout.source_columns, layout.source_rows, flag_1eeee0_nonzero=True)
+    if layout != reference:
+        raise MiniMapContractUnknown("layout fields do not match native counters")
+    if (type(column) is not int or type(row) is not int
+            or not 0 <= column < layout.overlay_columns
+            or not 0 <= row < layout.overlay_rows):
+        raise MiniMapContractUnknown("overlay vertex index outside mesh")
+    c = column if row % 2 == 0 else layout.overlay_columns - 1 - column
+    first = row * layout.overlay_columns * 2 + c * 2
+    second = first + 1
+    return first, second

+"""Original EXE *local* skill category and capability-flag assembly contracts.
+
+Only saved native ranges 0x5739E4..0x573A48, 0x577843..0x577997.
+A computed result is the local REGISTER/FLAG update of these branches,
+not proof the original battle AI chooses, launches or executes that skill.
+
+Skill+0x40 kinds 5/6 have special paths (including +0x130 pointer writer)
+which MUST NOT be projected into the ordinary 1..4 flag writer.
+0x577843 action dispatch is also entered under extra function preconditions
+(kind+0x40==8, +0x120!=0); unknown/failing gates stay unverified.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+
+class NativeSkillContractUnknown(ValueError):
+    """Insufficient native evidence to assert the requested local branch."""
+
+
+NATIVE_FLAG_VA_START=0x5739E4
+NATIVE_FLAG_VA_END=0x573A48
+NATIVE_ACTION_VA_START=0x577843
+NATIVE_ACTION_VA_END=0x577997
+
+# These are raw byte *offsets* in Unit, not effective gameplay skill names.
+ACTION_BRANCHES={
+    "sword": (0x134,1,0),
+    "bow": (0x135,2,0),
+    "magic": (0x136,2,1),
+    "heal": (0x137,3,0),
+    "care": (0x137,3,1),
+    "powerup": (0x137,3,2),
+    "summon": (0x138,4,0),
+}
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True,slots=True)
+class LocalCapabilityWrite:
+    skill_kind_40:int
+    written_unit_byte_offsets:tuple[int,...]
+    field_278_nonzero:bool
+    field_4c_positive:bool
+    source_va_begin:int=NATIVE_FLAG_VA_START
+    source_va_end:int=NATIVE_FLAG_VA_END
+    original_native_execution_observed:bool=False
+    full_skill_capabilities_reconstructed:bool=False
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True,slots=True)
+class LocalActionDispatch:
+    action_name:str
+    source_skill_kind_40:int
+    required_unit_byte_offset:int
+    written_kind_value:int
+    written_subtype_value:int
+    source_va_begin:int=NATIVE_ACTION_VA_START
+    source_va_end:int=NATIVE_ACTION_VA_END
+    actual_game_skill_invoked:bool=False
+    effective_skill_set_resolved:bool=False
+
+
+def _raw_s32(value:int,label:str)->int:
+    if type(value) is not int or not -(1<<31)<=value<(1<<31):
+        raise NativeSkillContractUnknown(label+" requires signed 32-bit raw value")
+    return value
+
+
+def one_resolved_skill_local_flag_writes(
+    kind_40:int,raw_278:int,raw_4c:int
+)->LocalCapabilityWrite:
+    """Return only the Unit byte-offset writes of the saved x86 branch.
+
+    Does not decide whether an original skill entered this scanner or
+    whether a 1 at one offset remains in the *final* capability cache.
+    """
+    _raw_s32(kind_40,"Skill+0x40")
+    _raw_s32(raw_278,"Skill+0x278")
+    _raw_s32(raw_4c,"Skill+0x4C")
+    # Kind 5 writes the first pointer at Unit+0x130 and kind 6 branches
+    # past this ordinary scanner; stop instead of silently treating as zero.
+    if kind_40 not in (1,2,3,4):
+        raise NativeSkillContractUnknown(
+            "only ordinary 1..4 native skill-kind flag paths are reconstructed"
+        )
+    target={
+        1:0x134,
+        2:0x136 if raw_278!=0 else 0x135,
+        3:0x137,
+        4:0x138,
+    }[kind_40]
+    offsets=(target,0x139) if raw_4c>0 else (target,)
+    return LocalCapabilityWrite(
+        kind_40,offsets,raw_278!=0,raw_4c>0
+    )
+
+
+def local_action_subtype_under_verified_preconditions(
+    action_name:str,
+    unit_capability_byte_offsets:tuple[int,...],
+    *,
+    skill_kind_40:int,
+    field_120_nonzero:bool
+)->LocalActionDispatch:
+    """Assert result ONLY for 0x577843..997 success branches.
+
+    This disassembly segment first checks Skill+0x40==8 and
+    Skill+0x120!=0. Missing capability means branch FALLTHROUGH to
+    0x577999 etc, not a proof of globally rejected action.
+    """
+    if (not isinstance(action_name,str)
+            or not isinstance(unit_capability_byte_offsets,tuple)
+            or any(type(v) is not int for v in unit_capability_byte_offsets)
+            or type(field_120_nonzero) is not bool):
+        raise NativeSkillContractUnknown("typed action and capability preconditions required")
+    if skill_kind_40!=8 or not field_120_nonzero:
+        raise NativeSkillContractUnknown(
+            "0x577843 dispatch action gate is not satisfied"
+        )
+    if action_name not in ACTION_BRANCHES:
+        raise NativeSkillContractUnknown(
+            "action string has no saved confirmed subtype branch"
+        )
+    offset,kind,subtype=ACTION_BRANCHES[action_name]
+    if offset not in unit_capability_byte_offsets:
+        raise NativeSkillContractUnknown(
+            "required Unit capability byte false: downstream fallback unknown"
+        )
+    return LocalActionDispatch(action_name,skill_kind_40,offset,kind,subtype)

+"""Compare catalog snapshot SHA256 values to reviewed repository text bodies.
+
+Original PC research paths are metadata only and are never opened by this tool.
+"""
+import argparse
+import collections
+import csv
+import hashlib
+import io
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+CATALOG_COLUMNS = ("path", "sha256", "bytes", "lines", "va_mentions", "owner", "tasks", "domain", "research_id")
+OUTPUT_COLUMNS = CATALOG_COLUMNS + ("coverage", "destinations")
+LEDGERS = (
+    "research/recovered/RECOVERY_LEDGER.tsv",
+    "research/recovered/exp/EXP_RECOVERY_LEDGER.tsv",
+    "research/recovered/dev_evidence/DEV_EVIDENCE_LEDGER.tsv",
+)
+OUTPUT_TSV = "research/recovered/COVERAGE.tsv"
+OUTPUT_MD = "research/recovered/COVERAGE.md"
+
+
+def repository_file(root, relative):
+    path = Path(relative)
+    resolved = (root / path).resolve()
+    if path.is_absolute() or not resolved.is_relative_to(root):
+        raise ValueError(f"Path escapes repository: {relative}")
+    if not resolved.is_file() or (root / path).is_symlink():
+        raise ValueError(f"Missing or linked repository file: {relative}")
+    return resolved
+
+
+def records(path):
+    with path.open(encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as stream:
+        return list(csv.DictReader(stream, delimiter="\t"))
+
+
+def inventory(root, tracked_paths):
+    root = Path(root).resolve()
+    catalog = records(root / "RESEARCH_SOURCE_CATALOG.tsv")
+    bodies = collections.defaultdict(set)
+    variants = collections.defaultdict(set)
+    for relative in sorted(set(tracked_paths) - {OUTPUT_TSV, OUTPUT_MD}):
+        path = repository_file(root, relative)
+        payload = path.read_bytes()
+        if b"\x00" in payload:
+            continue
+        try:
+            payload.decode("utf-8-sig")
+        except UnicodeError:
+            continue
+        bodies[hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()].add(relative)
+    for relative in LEDGERS:
+        ledger = root / relative
+        if not ledger.exists():
+            continue
+        for row in records(repository_file(root, relative)):
+            destination = row["destination"]
+            payload = repository_file(root, destination).read_bytes()
+            digest = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
+            if digest != row["destination_sha256"].lower():
+                raise ValueError(f"Ledger destination checksum mismatch: {destination}")
+            if b"\x00" in payload:
+                raise ValueError(f"Recovered body is not text: {destination}")
+            payload.decode("utf-8-sig")
+            if not row.get("review", "").strip():
+                raise ValueError(f"Missing source review: {destination}")
+            source_digest = row["source_sha256"].lower()
+            bodies[digest].add(destination)
+            if digest != source_digest:
+                variants[(row["source_path"], source_digest)].add(destination)
+    result = []
+    for row in catalog:
+        if any(column not in row for column in CATALOG_COLUMNS):
+            raise ValueError("Catalog is missing required columns")
+        digest = row["sha256"].lower()
+        exact = bodies.get(digest, set())
+        reviewed = variants.get((row["path"], digest), set())
+        state = "CATALOG_ONLY_UNRESOLVED"
+        if exact:
+            state = "EXACT_BODY_AVAILABLE"
+        elif reviewed:
+            state = "RECOVERED_REVIEWED_VARIANT"
+        result.append({**row, "coverage": state, "destinations": ";".join(sorted(exact or reviewed))})
+    return result
+
+
+def render(rows):
+    stream = io.StringIO(newline="")
+    writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=OUTPUT_COLUMNS, delimiter="\t", lineterminator="\n")
+    writer.writeheader()
+    writer.writerows(rows)
+    counts = collections.Counter(row["coverage"] for row in rows)
+    lines = ["# 研究本文の収録範囲", "",
+             "RESEARCH_SOURCE_CATALOG.tsv の既存スナップショットを、Git管理対象のテキスト本文とレビュー済み回収台帳に照合した一覧。",
+             "[全行の照合結果](COVERAGE.tsv)から元の相対パス、SHA256、研究ID、保存先を追跡できる。", "",
+             "| 状態 | 行数 | 意味 |", "|---|---:|---|",
+             f"| EXACT_BODY_AVAILABLE | {counts['EXACT_BODY_AVAILABLE']} | 同じSHA256の本文をリポジトリ内で確認 |",
+             f"| RECOVERED_REVIEWED_VARIANT | {counts['RECOVERED_REVIEWED_VARIANT']} | 元SHAと保存版SHAを持つレビュー済み別版を確認 |",
+             f"| CATALOG_ONLY_UNRESOLVED | {counts['CATALOG_ONLY_UNRESOLVED']} | 同じ本文やレビュー済み別版の対応を、この検査では確認できていない |", "",
+             f"対象は目録の {len(rows)} 行。未解決行にも別名の要約・訂正・出典参照が存在し得る。SHAの文字列が資料中に登場しただけでは本文収録と数えない。",
+             "目録のSHAは採録時点の値。研究PCの現在の文書との一致、研究の確かさ、GitHubへの送信完了はこの表だけでは判定しない。",
+             "目録作成後に追加された研究や、目録に含まれないファイルの全件把握も別途必要になる。原作素材・保留原資料にはアクセスしない。", "",
+             "再生成は `python tools/recovery_coverage.py build`、鮮度確認は `python tools/recovery_coverage.py check`。", ""]
+    return {OUTPUT_TSV: stream.getvalue(), OUTPUT_MD: "\n".join(lines)}
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("command", choices=("build", "check"))
+    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, default=ROOT)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    root = args.root.resolve()
+    try:
+        tracked = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(root), "ls-files", "-z"], capture_output=True, check=True).stdout.decode("utf-8").split("\0")
+        rows = inventory(root, [path for path in tracked if path])
+        files = render(rows)
+        for relative, content in files.items():
+            path = root / relative
+            if args.command == "build":
+                path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+                path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
+            elif not path.is_file() or path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") != content:
+                raise ValueError(f"Coverage output is stale: {relative}")
+        print(f"{args.command.upper()} PASS ({len(rows)} catalog rows)")
+        return 0
+    except (ValueError, KeyError, OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError) as error:
+        print(f"Coverage error: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Check exact source coverage without reading original PC research files."""
+import csv
+import hashlib
+from pathlib import Path
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+
+import recovery_coverage as coverage
+
+
+class CoverageTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
+        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
+        self.body = b"original finding\n"
+        self.sha = hashlib.sha256(self.body).hexdigest()
+        self.catalog([("local/report.md", self.sha)])
+
+    def catalog(self, entries):
+        with (self.root / "RESEARCH_SOURCE_CATALOG.tsv").open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as stream:
+            writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=coverage.CATALOG_COLUMNS, delimiter="\t", lineterminator="\n")
+            writer.writeheader()
+            for path, sha in entries:
+                writer.writerow(dict(path=path, sha256=sha, bytes="17", lines="1", va_mentions="0", owner="DEV", tasks="T001", domain="UI", research_id="R1"))
+
+    def ledger(self, destinations):
+        path = self.root / coverage.LEDGERS[0]
+        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as stream:
+            writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=("source_path", "source_sha256", "destination", "destination_sha256", "review"), delimiter="\t", lineterminator="\n")
+            writer.writeheader()
+            for destination, digest in destinations:
+                writer.writerow(dict(source_path="local/report.md", source_sha256=self.sha, destination=destination, destination_sha256=digest, review="Reviewed text"))
+
+    def test_hash_mention_does_not_count_as_body(self):
+        (self.root / "summary.md").write_text("Source SHA: " + self.sha, encoding="utf-8")
+        rows = coverage.inventory(self.root, ["summary.md"])
+        self.assertEqual(rows[0]["coverage"], "CATALOG_ONLY_UNRESOLVED")
+
+    def test_identical_body_under_other_name_counts(self):
+        (self.root / "renamed.md").write_bytes(self.body)
+        rows = coverage.inventory(self.root, ["renamed.md"])
+        self.assertEqual(rows[0]["coverage"], "EXACT_BODY_AVAILABLE")
+        self.assertEqual(rows[0]["destinations"], "renamed.md")
+
+    def test_every_catalog_row_retained(self):
+        self.catalog([("local/report.md", self.sha), ("duplicate/report.md", self.sha)])
+        rows = coverage.inventory(self.root, [])
+        self.assertEqual([row["path"] for row in rows], ["local/report.md", "duplicate/report.md"])
+        self.assertEqual(rows[0]["research_id"], "R1")
+
+    def test_reviewed_variant_and_duplicate_receipts(self):
+        for name in ("safe.md", "second.md"):
+            (self.root / name).write_text("Reviewed redacted version", encoding="utf-8")
+        sha = hashlib.sha256((self.root / "safe.md").read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+        self.ledger([("safe.md", sha), ("safe.md", sha), ("second.md", sha)])
+        rows = coverage.inventory(self.root, [])
+        self.assertEqual(rows[0]["coverage"], "RECOVERED_REVIEWED_VARIANT")
+        self.assertEqual(rows[0]["destinations"], "safe.md;second.md")
+
+    def test_stale_ledger_and_path_escape_rejected(self):
